name: thinkai-ui-deprecated
description: Deprecation mapping of retired ThinkAI UI kit primitives to core registry components.

arrow-roll.reason: Folded into tai-button as kinetic arrow subcomponent.

button-text-roll.reason: Folded into tai-button as rollText variant.

text-roll.reason: Folded into tai-button as typography roll subcomponent.

tai-input.reason: Generic form primitive retired from core registry; available in package @thinkai-studio/ui.

tai-select.reason: Generic form primitive retired from core registry; available in package @thinkai-studio/ui.

tai-checkbox.reason: Generic control primitive retired from core registry; available in package @thinkai-studio/ui.

tai-switch.reason: Generic control primitive retired from core registry; available in package @thinkai-studio/ui.

tai-tabs.reason: Use tai-header navigation islands or package @thinkai-studio/ui.

tai-accordion.reason: Use about-drawer progressive disclosure or package @thinkai-studio/ui.

tai-dialog.reason: Replaced by architecture-modal and contact-modal overlay primitives.

tai-toast.reason: Use contact-modal feedback toast or package @thinkai-studio/ui.

fade-in.reason: Use masked-text-reveal or standard Motion enter transitions.

tai-tooltip.reason: Use tai-icon-button with accessible title or package @thinkai-studio/ui.

tai-alert.reason: Use contact-modal telemetry feedback or package @thinkai-studio/ui.

tai-badge.reason: Use tai-button sm/icon variant or package @thinkai-studio/ui.

tai-skeleton.reason: Use product-mockup container state or package @thinkai-studio/ui.

tai-separator.reason: Use standard border hairlines or tai-header dividers.

tai-avatar.reason: Use about-drawer portrait frame or package @thinkai-studio/ui.

tai-empty-state.reason: Use product-mockup fallback layout or package @thinkai-studio/ui.

tai-bottom-sheet.reason: Consolidated into about-drawer mobile sheet mechanics.

tai-status-indicator.reason: Use tai-icon-button with LED status indicator.

tai-code-block.reason: Generic code block primitive moved to package @thinkai-studio/ui.

tai-kbd.reason: Use tai-button sm size or native kbd.
